items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Count Basie; the interviewer mentions Basie in relation to other musicians (Harry, Taddy).

ctx.x: I had to revise my thinking too, because I said--no, I don't think Harry was in that band when we broke up in Albany.
I know he got his reputation Jeter and Pillars, he stayed down there until he came up and then he got with Basie right after that.
